chapter: Oliver, Kelly and the district bands
title: Names of early bands and downtown versus uptown style
summary: Dawson recalls Blaze Away, Eureka, Olympia and Tuxedo; the Blaze Away was a small Creole band and all played similar Dixieland.

story.theme_name: Brass bands, parades and jazz funerals
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

Well, they had the blaze away band The blaze away they had Let me see Well, Eureka The blaze away And The Let's see The The Olympia The Olympia The blaze away The The Tuxedo Eureka I mean they had the They had uh Let me see now
